name: Path to Moksha
reason: Health-claim rule: Path to Moksha (Justin Daniel, Stone Mountain, Georgia) is a sound-healing brand whose YouTube channel (@thepathtomoksha, 221k) is music-only frequency tracks titled around insomnia, cortisol, anxiety and 'healing', and whose channel description promises to help the body heal, boost immunity and rebalance hormones; the in-person offer is sound-therapy sessions framed as physical and mental healing. Nothing teachable passes the rules.
